AVIRUP BHATTACHARJEE

        San Diego, CA | (619) 806-8866 | avirup.b26@gmail.com | LinkedIn

TECHNICAL SKILLS
GIS Platforms & Mapping: ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, QGIS, Google Earth Pro, Web Maps, Dashboards, Map
Layouts, Thematic Mapping
Geodatabases, Spatial Analysis & Automation: Enterprise/File Geodatabases, Feature Classes, Shapefiles, Attribute Tables, Domains, Subtypes,
Metadata, Spatial Data Standards, Spatial Joins, Buffer/Overlay/Proximity Analysis, Geocoding, Projection Management, Coordinate Systems,
Python, ArcPy, ModelBuilder
Field Data & QA/QC: ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, GPS Data Collection, Mobile Forms, Field Verification, Geometry Validation, Attribute
Review, Topology Checks, Duplicate Cleanup, Projection Error Correction
Municipal & Infrastructure Mapping: Parcel Mapping, Zoning Maps, Land Use Mapping, Utility Mapping, Road Centerlines, Municipal
Boundaries, Infrastructure Assets, Planning Exhibits, Permit Support Maps

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

BAYSHORE COMMUNICATION                                                                                                                           Jul 2025 – Present
  GIS Analyst                                                                                                                                                                              Tampa, FL
•  Maintained and supported enterprise geodatabases supporting over 1,200 miles of utility, municipal, and infrastructure

•

data across 15+ jurisdictions.
Supported and coordinated spatial data QA/QC workflows across a 4-person GIS team, resolving geometry, attribute,
projection, and data integrity issues for 25,000+ mapped addresses.

•  Developed and automated geoprocessing workflows using Python, ArcPy, ModelBuilder, and ArcGIS Pro, reducing

•

•

•

manual data update time by 30%.
Produced and maintained 200+ map products, web maps, and dashboards for internal stakeholders, planning teams, field
operations, and public-facing applications using ArcGIS Online.
Integrated GPS-collected field data from ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123 into centralized GIS databases, improving
spatial accuracy across active projects.
Standardized feature classes, domains, attribute rules, metadata, naming conventions, and layer structures to improve
database consistency and long-term usability.

•  Trained incoming GIS analysts and interns on data standards, workflow processes, map production procedures, and quality

control requirements.

SWOP TECHNOLOGIES                                                                                                                                         Mar 2025 – Jul 2025
   GIS Technician                                                                                                                                                                    Charlotte, NC

•  Maintained and updated geodatabases for over 600 miles of infrastructure, parcel, zoning, and land use data using

ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and QGIS.

•  Created 80+ map layouts, exhibits, and spatial data reports for internal planning, permitting review, field coordination,

•

and client documentation.
Performed data digitization, attribute entry, geocoding, and feature editing for approximately 5,000 spatial features,
ensuring alignment with organizational data standards.

•  Assisted with field data collection using GPS units and ArcGIS Field Maps, integrating collected data into ArcGIS Pro for

database updates and review.

•  Conducted QA/QC checks on incoming spatial data, identifying and correcting geometry errors, missing attributes, duplicate

records, and projection issues prior to publication.

•  Reviewed aerial imagery, parcel layers, road centerlines, and public GIS datasets to verify feature locations and improve

spatial accuracy.

C4RE                                                                                                                                                                        Jan 2025 – Mar 2025
   Engineer I                                                                                                                                                                             Arlington, TX

•

Supported GIS analysts in digitizing and updating parcel, zoning, land use, and infrastructure datasets for 10+ municipal
planning projects, using ArcGIS and AutoCAD to review base maps, site layouts, and infrastructure reference drawings.

•  Assisted with GPS field data collection using ArcGIS Field Maps, handheld GPS units, and mobile forms; organized GIS/CAD

datasets and supported map production while performing QA/QC checks for attributes, labels, duplicates, geometry, and drawing
accuracy.

EDUCATION
The University of Texas at Arlington                                                                                                                                        Dec 2024
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science                                                                                                                              Arlington, TX
*Open to relocating anywhere within the United States                                                                                                                     Honors: Magna Cum Laude
